title: CompAct-Bench: A Benchmark for Working-Context Compaction in Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As language-model agents are applied to increasingly extended tasks, their working context continuously accumulates interaction history, tool observations, intermediate decisions, and task progress. Context compaction offers a practical way to reduce this growing history while allowing execution to continue, yet the compaction ability of modern LLMs remains insufficiently understood. We introduce CompAct-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating working-context compaction through its downstream effect on agent task completion. Starting from successful agent trajectories, we insert compaction boundaries at different stages of execution, compress the preceding working context with the model under evaluation, and let the same executor continue the original task. To enable fair comparison across compactors, we evaluate them under controlled retention ratios using a lightweight iterative ratio-adjustment procedure. CompAct-Bench covers information-se

translated_title: CompAct-Bench：面向长周期智能体任务中工作上下文压缩的基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着语言模型智能体被应用于日益延长的任务，其工作上下文会不断累积交互历史、工具观测结果、中间决策和任务进度。上下文压缩提供了一种在允许任务执行继续进行的同时缩减这一不断增长的历史的实用方法，然而现代大语言模型的压缩能力仍未被充分理解。我们提出了 CompAct-Bench，这是一个通过压缩对智能体任务完成情况的下游影响来评估工作上下文压缩能力的基准测试。该基准从成功的智能体轨迹出发，在任务执行的不同阶段插入压缩边界，使用被评估的模型压缩先前的工作上下文，然后让同一个执行器继续完成原始任务。为了实现对不同压缩器的公平比较，我们在受控的保留率下，采用一种轻量级的迭代式比例调整程序对它们进行评估。CompAct-Bench 涵盖了信息……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 CompAct-Bench 基准，通过压缩上下文后智能体能否继续成功完成原始任务的下游效果，来评估大语言模型在长周期智能体任务中的工作上下文压缩能力。
en_tdlr: CompAct-Bench is a benchmark that evaluates working-context compaction in LLMs by measuring its downstream effect on agent task completion, using controlled retention ratios for fair comparison across compactors in long-horizon tasks.
